agents: The Tree and Graph switch is not drawn (left out of v1). Otherwise the same rows, bars and opened row.
assets: Name and what it is sit in two columns where the mockup runs them together. The header counts its rows (11, 6 covered). The opened row's note still reads "both filed as findings": those are the sample row's own words, no view adds them.
changes: Same. In a pane under 420 points the bar drops its controls and says "vs main · a1b9f3e", as frame 1 does.
chat-doc: No bell and no window buttons in the title row (just chat is chat only). No Edit on the card. The card's buttons are 20 points high where the mockup's are 26. With every block's margin facts shown at once, as the fixture's hover pose needs, two fact groups overlap beside the steps list; one block at a time shows them in use.
chat: The card is the record's three rows (91 high), newer than the still's. No Edit button. A folded Turn 1 line sits above the prompt. The composer also shows the thread's mode beside the model.
code: The footer counts the file's own 23 lines.
containers: The header names the engine alone: Docker's rows name no host. No memory total. Rows have no small Logs, Shell and Restart icons at their right end; the opened row has the buttons.
context-menu: The hint beside Find references is Cmd-click. The address is built from the record's id.
context-tray: Same chips and address line; the address is built from record ids.
debugger: Variables are a list whose rows open in place, so the picked variable shows its facts and buttons. The call stack's heading does not name the thread, and the parked threads are not listed. Breakpoint marks in the list are white where the mockup's are red.
design: No Layers tab. No Return keycap on Hand to agent.
desktop: The bar has Mark up beside Watch and Control (record 4.9.2), so the size text is cut shorter.
files: Section labels are in capitals, as frame 1 draws them; frame 20 writes them in sentence case.
findings-checks: Same lines and switches, now with the line that says a finding can become a check. No New button of its own.
findings-gate: Three checks, not five: Tests pass and No errors in changed files are not drawn.
findings-place: Six places, each with an open finding; no By source tab. The footer says a press filters the list.
findings-table: The header says 5 open and its chips add up to 5: the two suggestions are not counted until accepted.
findings: One list with the picked finding opened in place, instead of a list beside a detail pane. 7 open, and the chips add up to 7 (High 1, Med 2, Low 4). No Board tab, no closed findings. The two suggestions also offer Merge.
logs: The footer counts what is listed (15 lines, 2 warnings). With a line open the list says paused and offers Jump to latest.
lsp-code: The footer counts 23 lines. The quick-fix bar repeats the problem's whole sentence and also offers Ask agent.
lsp: The opened server's switch sits with its facts at the left, not at the right of the buttons.
menu-bar: No scene can show it: the Mac draws the menu bar and the status menu, not a view. The titles, the rows and the first ask's Return key are checked by the menubar tests and looked at in the real window (target/realwin/out/menubar.png).
new-chat: No bell count in the title row. The column is 770 wide like the document's. The send button is an arrow while nothing runs.
plugin-kit: No scene of the whole frame: its chat and its two source files exist only as on-screen text, not as a recorded turn or files a scene could load. plugin-kit/kit and script/queue-depth draw the two panes that have fixtures.
plugins: A plain list: one 20 point row a plugin with what it adds in a column, opened in place. No letter badge, no enable switch, no update marks, no Browse or Updates tab, no Find, no permission switches (the May reach and May not facts say them).
references: The header gives the count without the word function. The hint names Cmd-click. Added-line marks show in the gutter.
report: The zoom reads 48% at this width.
settings-groups: A flat list of the seven groups that hold a shipped setting, with no nesting; the mockup lists seventeen names.
settings-text: Same form; it lists the 7 values that differ.
settings: The All tab is in front, since the app's Appearance group holds five of the mockup's ten rows; groups follow one another with Appearance first. No Project and This thread scopes. Each changed row offers reset.
shell-folded: The strip lists every thread; the mockup's stops at eight.
terminal: The agent's tab names its whole command.
theme-tokens: The editor lists all 116 values in more groups; no Edit theme or As text tab.
themes: Same list; the editor beside it is longer.
vms: The memory column shows the share and the total ("62% of 8 GB"), so it is wider. No memory or disk total in the header, no last snapshot in the footer.
whole-window: Chat draws its steps one a row, not the tile's folded "Read 1 file, searched once, edited 2 files", and also shows the second answer. Files shows the window's own thread and git feed (two changed files, tests folded). The terminal's second tab names the whole command. The strip lists every thread. The Mac's menu bar is not part of the window.
